requirement: Equivalent deterministic semantic/build inputs produce the same Forge artifact identity.
Invariant-violating transforms are rejected and cannot become valid promotion candidates.
Meta programs cannot mint capabilities; undeclared requests are denied by the external authority seam.
Compile errors normalize to structured diagnostics with stable compiler/version identity.
Current compiler/conformance/source evidence outranks conflicting model prior and conflict is recorded.
Semantic migration emits dry-run semantic diff before application and declares idempotency expectation.
ForgeExperimentProfile requires a canonical Axon experiment reference rather than owning a second lifecycle.
ForgeEvidencePayload requires a canonical Axon/CX-32 evidence reference.
ResourceProjection identifies authoritative source and is explicitly non-authoritative for dispatch.
A new Forge transform can be registered without compiler-specific changes to Axon Core.
ForgeStrategyProfile references a canonical StrategyArtifact identity.
IntentIR and Forge SIR remain distinct representations with an explicit lowering/constraint seam.
Subject code cannot mutate the frozen evaluator/admission authority used to judge itself.
BuildProgram requests external capabilities and emits a deterministic BuildGraph.
Forge v0.2 generic authority schemas are not normative in v0.3.
